summary: Action bar for selected items, with an announced count, a clear button, and optional sticky positioning.
whenToUse: Managing selected pages, media, or users.
Composing bulk actions next to a DataTable or list.
whenNotToUse: Replacing confirmations and permissions for destructive actions.
Adding a toolbar with arrow-key navigation: use Toolbar.

props.name: count
props.description: Non-negative safe integer. Zero hides the bar; invalid values throw a RangeError.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Shows the localized button to clear the selection.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Sticky positioning toward the bottom of the container.

props.name: children
props.description: The consumer's actual actions, with disabled/pending states managed by the application.

inherits: HTML attributes of div, aria-label, className, style, and an HTMLDivElement ref.

keyboard.action: Standard navigation between actions and the clear button.

accessibility: Named group, with the count in role=status.
Does not move focus automatically. When the bar disappears, the consumer restores focus if needed.
responsive: Actions and count wrap; sticky is not a fixed overlay.
customization: Brand surface, selected border, and radius tokens; data-sticky.
commonMistakes: Not keeping count in sync with the actual selection.
Hiding the bar while focus is on one of its actions without handling focus restoration.
limits: Does not handle selection, authorization, confirmations, or server transactions.
Sticky depends on the consumer's scroll container.
